skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts related to culture such as origin, characteristics, and functions.
Understand the relationship between culture and the natural environment.
Analyze cultural concepts and their interrelatedness.
Analyze the principles of Yin-Yang philosophy and their influence on Vietnamese culture.
Analyze the interaction and exchange of Vietnamese culture with other cultures.
Analyze the unique characteristics of regional cultures in Vietnam.
Demonstrate initiative in learning, research, and group work.
Develop awareness and respect for traditional culture and customs.
Develop awareness and respect for maintaining and promoting traditional values.
